raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "2026.4" %}
# The SPIRV-Headers revision pinned by v{{ version }}'s DEPS.
{% set headers_version = "1.4.363.0" %}

package:
  name: spirv-tools-split
  version: "{{ version }}"

source:
  url: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Tools/archive/refs/tags/v{{ version }}.zip
  sha256: c2399673510cfaa515e9197db18c2ae5860925f497ad8735c93f00f931c41cbd
  patches:
    - 0001-Get-package-version-and-description-from-conda-build.patch
    # Export the C++ API with dllexport/dllimport instead of
    # CMAKE_WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS. Not upstream yet, see
    # https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Tools/issues/3909
    - 0002-Export-the-CXX-API-of-the-shared-libraries.patch

build:
  number: 2

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - {{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake
    - make    # [unix]
    - ninja   # [win]
    - python >=3
  host:
    - spirv-headers {{ headers_version }}

outputs:
  - name: spirv-tools
    script: install.sh   # [unix]
    script: install.bat  # [win]
    build:
      run_exports:
        # They seem to be using calver, so their version numbers are not very informative
        # But we expect these to be rather stable
        # so lets try 'x' https://github.com/conda-forge/spirv-tools-feedstock/issues/3
        - {{ pin_subpackage('spirv-tools', 'x') }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
      host:
        - spirv-headers {{ headers_version }}
      run_constrained:
        - {{ pin_compatible('spirv-headers', max_pin='x.x.x.x') }}
    test:
      requires:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      files:
        - test/CMakeLists.txt
        - test/main.cpp
        - test/compute.spvasm
      commands:
        - spirv-as -h
        # Run the optimizer through the command line tools
        - spirv-as test/compute.spvasm -o compute.spv
        - spirv-val compute.spv
        - spirv-opt --strip-debug compute.spv -o stripped.spv
        - spirv-opt -O compute.spv -o optimized.spv
        - spirv-val optimized.spv
        - test ! -e ${PREFIX}/include/spirv-tools-private  # [unix]
        - if exist %LIBRARY_INC%\spirv-tools-private exit 1  # [win]
        # MSVC single-config generators default to a Debug build, whose debug C++
        # runtime and STL layouts are not ABI compatible with the Release DLLs.
        - cmake -G Ninja -S test -B test-build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
        - cmake --build test-build
        - ./test-build/test-spirv-tools  # [unix]
        - test-build\\test-spirv-tools.exe  # [win]

  - name: spirv-tools-internal
    script: install_internal.sh   # [unix]
    script: install_internal.bat  # [win]
    build:
      run_exports:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('spirv-tools', max_pin='x.x') }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - cmake
      host:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('spirv-tools', exact=True) }}
        - spirv-headers {{ headers_version }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_subpackage('spirv-tools', exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_compatible('spirv-headers', max_pin='x.x.x.x') }}
    test:
      requires:
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      files:
        - test-internal/CMakeLists.txt
        - test-internal/main.cpp
      commands:
        - test -f ${PREFIX}/include/spirv-tools-private/source/opt/build_module.h  # [unix]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\spirv-tools-private\source\opt\build_module.h exit 1  # [win]
        - cmake -G Ninja -S test-internal -B test-build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
        - cmake --build test-build
        - ./test-build/test-spirv-tools-internal  # [unix]
        - test-build\\test-spirv-tools-internal.exe  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Tools
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: The SPIR-V Tools project provides an API and commands for processing SPIR-V modules.

extra:
  feedstock-name: spirv-tools

    - ZzEeKkAa
    - isuruf
    - hmaarrfk

    - baszalmstra
